This is the third regular chapter of the [[Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game XY!]] manga.

== Plot ==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Manabu Kadoo|Manabu]] pulls a [[M Venusaur-EX (XY 2)|M Venusaur-EX]] from a pack and [[Hiroshi Uratane|Uratane]] decides now is finally the time to explain how [[Mega Evolution]] works. He decides to do this in a game using 60 card standard decks and 6 Prize cards to be more interesting to teach. For this, He tasks Manabu to build a 60 card deck by tomorrow with the {{DL|Pokémon-EX (TCG)|Mega Evolution Pokémon}} Manabu pulled. Uratane also explains how Mega Evolution needs to be done from a {{tcg|Basic Pokémon|Basic}} {{tcg|Pokémon-EX}} rather than a {{tcg|Stage 2 Pokémon}}. However, Manabu has significant trouble building the deck around just 1 card as the odds of him getting to it in a game are slim. But after a moment of inspiration, he is able to construct his 60 card deck and challenges Uratane to a battle. It is revealed Manabu filled his deck with {{tcg|Trainer card}}s with draw effects to get to M Venusaur-EX more quickly while Uratane filled his deck with Trainer cards that can specifically search his deck. An intense battle takes place between Manabu's M Venusaur-EX and Uratane's [[M Blastoise-EX (XY 30)|M Blastoise-EX]], where Uratane explains that a turn automatically ends once you Mega Evolve. However, before their game can properly conclude, they are interrupted by a strange man who gives Manabu an offer.
